init.title: Klar NLU
init.description: The personality is stored here, so it survives reinstalling the Klar app. Assist and the LLM refine voice follow it on every reply.

data.refine_speech: Let the LLM refine NLU replies
data.assist_filter: Only control entities exposed to Assist

data_description.personality: Stored in this integration, not in the Klar app. Assist and the LLM refine voice switch with this choice. With refine on, the voice lives in the sentence, not in a fixed cue.
data_description.refine_speech: When on, device control still comes from Klar NLU, but the fallback LLM rewrites the finished NLU reply as one or two spoken sentences in the selected personality. Klar sends enable_thinking=false on that request.
data_description.refine_prompt: Optional extra style on top of the selected personality. Klar still keeps the safety rules: no device control, no new facts, same language.
data_description.token: Same token as the Klar add-on. Needed for overlay writes from Home Assistant.
data_description.assist_filter: Developer option. On (default): Klar changes only what Assist may see. Off: match hidden sensors and switches too — easier to hit the wrong device.
data_description.nlu_rag: Off by default. When on, chat and empty rejects send the already-matched slice to the fallback model. The model may recover a command only through Klar tools, never Assist or Home Assistant control tools.
data_description.languages: Every compiled Assist locale. Empty or all selected means all are enabled. Assist still pins one pack per request so lexicons are not merged together.
data_description.channel: Bundled engine only. Stable downloads the current CalVer GitHub Release. Staging downloads the latest staging prerelease. Reload Klar NLU after switching. Add-on users install Klar NLU (Staging) instead.
